The staffing board follows one shift from
offers to clock-out. This tutorial uses

Open Venue Offers in the sidebar, and
select a shift.

Along the top, Required, Filled and Open
count the places on the shift, followed by

The board has twelve lanes. People move
from Offered and Waiting, through Staff

Accepted and Confirmed, to Clocked in,
Pending Review and Clocked out. Anyone who

drops out moves to No Show, Rejected,
Cancelled or Deleted.

Each card shows the person and their
latest state, such as when they clocked

Go back to Venue Offers, and open a shift
where everyone has clocked out.

Select Timesheet report to view or
download the timesheet.

The original timesheet is available as
soon as everyone has clocked out. The

venue signed version appears after the
venue manager reviews each person's hours

and finalises the report in the mobile
app.
